activation: explicit fi-agent run; no persistent Claude configuration changes
identity: Preserves native trace/span/parent IDs. HMAC native session and trace grouping. Native trace/span work IDs provide transport dedup only, not transcript aliases or provider-attempt identities.
timing: Native logical request interval including retries, not individual HTTP attempt latency.
accounting: Only native llm_request spans own additive inclusive input/output counters. Cache read/write included once in normalized input; missing cache fields leave inclusive input unavailable. No fabricated request attempts, summary charges or cost.
privacy: No prompt, response, tool input/output, arbitrary resource fields, user IDs, paths, error text or event bodies persist. Local short-lived header capability can be inherited by agent tools; same-UID processes are outside the boundary.
coexistence: Refuse unowned trace/generic endpoints, detailed beta routes, telemetry-bearing settings and detected managed policy. Keep unrelated existing per-signal exporters. No replacement or third-party fan-out.
